page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a two-column conjugation table in the middle (Italian left, Latin right). Running head at top with page number left and title right. Faint show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed.

main_text.head: ¶Declinatio Verbi substantiui.
main_text.p: Quoniam autem lingua Italica verbo Passiuo caret, sed eius loco vsurpat Verbum Sum, es, est, cum Participio passiuo, ideo substantiui verbi declinationem hic ponere operæpretium esse censeo.

page.notes: The Italian and Latin columns are set side by side; the Italian conjugation forms are copied as printed. The tables carry no marginal notes. Some ink on the right edge and show-through from the reverse page are omitted. Possible printing irregularities: "Præt.imperfect." and "Præt.perfect." appear as printed.
